name: pi-aftc-toolset
description: AFTC toolset: Footer widget with usage costs, cache, turns, ctx window I/O analysis etc. Additional shortcuts, SSH via a PyQt6 GUI isolating SSH credentials from pi and any AI model, skills (designed for low context), 3 themes and more.
